updates.title: Endpoint DLP Now Monitors FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention can now detect and restrict sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols, extending protection beyond traditional cloud services. Admins can configure these transfer activities directly in Endpoint DLP policies to enforce organizational data protection requirements across additional transfer channels.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Network Data Security Integrates with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Purview now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to monitor and protect sensitive data, files, and AI interactions at the network layer while enforcing DLP policies and detecting risky user behavior. This integration prevents data exfiltration to untrusted cloud applications including browsers, APIs, and generative AI platforms.

updates.title: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Report Now Available
updates.summary: Compliance admins can now generate reports to identify SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that fall out of compliance following Information Barriers policy changes. This new reporting capability helps teams quickly remediate policy violations and maintain data segregation controls.

updates.title: Endpoint DLP Extends Protection to Windows Excluded Folders
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now protects sensitive data stored in commonly excluded Windows folders such as Temp and AppData, closing a coverage gap where users might inadvertently store confidential information. This improvement strengthens data protection across the full Windows file system.

updates.title: DLP Policy Tips and Email Notifications Now Configurable Independently
updates.summary: Admins can now decouple policy tips from email notifications when configuring SharePoint and OneDrive DLP rules, allowing independent control over user-facing alerts and administrator notifications. This flexibility enables organizations to implement notification strategies tailored to their specific compliance and user experience needs.

updates.title: Communication Compliance Adds External Email Detection and Policy Testing
updates.summary: Communication Compliance policies now support detection of messages to and from external email addresses, introduce OR logic for combining multiple conditions, and allow testing policies before deployment. These enhancements give compliance teams finer control over external communication monitoring and reduce risk of misconfigured policies.

updates.title: Unified Classification Management Consolidates All Purview Classifiers
updates.summary: A new unified experience brings Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers into one management interface for discovery, creation, validation, and ongoing administration. This centralized approach simplifies classifier governance and reduces admin overhead across Microsoft Purview.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Adds Secure Hard Delete for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Compliance admins gain the ability to permanently hard-delete content in OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows, moving beyond the standard 93-day recycle bin retention. The feature includes safeguards to prevent accidental data loss while meeting strict compliance deletion requirements.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management Introduces Alert Classification
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management alerts can now be classified as True Positive, Benign (Operational), or False Positive with predefined classification reasons, enabling authorized analysts to better tune and report on risk signals. This replaces the previous dismissal workflow and supports more granular risk tuning.

updates.title: Legacy Teams Retention Policies Will No Longer Apply to Copilot Interactions
updates.summary: Existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams will be converted to Teams-only policies and will no longer implicitly govern Microsoft 365 Copilot workloads. Organizations should review and update retention strategies to ensure Copilot interactions are covered by appropriate policies if governance is required.
